title: Notice to all Onecoin members only two days to double everyone YouTube
description: to be part of the new global change, join the financial future by contacting us through ...

asr.full_text: Hello, how are you all? Hello to all the people in the team. We have a super important news to tell you. We just had a word from Dr. Rucha that all those who make their deposits before the end of the month and have their payment certificate, even though they cannot activate the accounts during those 30 days in September, will have the duplicated account, so let's give this message to all the people in the group within that 30 days of September, they will have the additional double of the bank accounts. So make sure to contact us so that those people can make their deposits, have their check reports and double them. We send you a big hug from Thailand to everyone and we look forward to having you here later.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes depositing money into the OneCoin-related scheme in exchange for a promised doubling of accounts, using a time-limited deadline and urging viewers to contact the group. The speaker presents the deposit and payment certificate as the route to receiving the duplicated accounts, rather than reporting or criticizing the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S03 fits because participation requires making deposits and is linked to an emphasized doubling benefit, representing a promised investment-related return. The video does not merely mention the offer; it actively directs members to deposit and contact the group before the deadline.
